A considered approach

Our Process

Three clear stages, tailored to the service and scope of your project.

  1. 01

    Pre-Production

    We align on your goals, audience, creative direction, deliverables, and timeline. Depending on the service, this may include concept development, planning, and preparation.

  2. 02

    Production

    We create the agreed work—capturing photos or video, designing visual assets, or producing motion graphics—according to the approved direction and schedule.

  3. 03

    Post-Production

    We refine and prepare the work for delivery. This may include editing, color and sound work, animation, design refinements, and exporting files in the agreed formats.
